one_line: Privacy-first redacted-document viewer with agent verification, human-approved reveals, and audit trails.
what_it_does: Exposes bounded WebMCP tools to view masked documents, verify guessed fields without revealing values, request one-time unmask approvals, challenge redactions, and inspect audit events.
leverage_rationale: The product makes the agent-facing security boundary and shared human approval state the core experience; ordinary UI-driving agents cannot comparably provide typed, non-leaking verification and at-most-once reveals.
leverage_evidence: Five tools are described, including verify_without_reveal, request_field_unmask, and get_redaction_audit_log.
One-time grants, rate limits, server-side events, and no raw values in DOM/storage/logs are central design claims.
execution_rationale: The security model is unusually specific and coherent, but there is no video and only packaging evidence, so actual implementation completeness is not demonstrated.
execution_evidence: ABOUT text specifies bounded tools, cursor pagination, human approval, consumed grants, and session-scoped challenge behavior.
No video frame sheets or transcript submitted.
impact_rationale: Sensitive-document workflows have a real need for controlled agent assistance, auditability, and minimization of disclosure.
impact_evidence: Targets document viewers where ordinary agent access can expose sensitive fields.
Explicitly addresses prompt/jailbreak/mistake risks and human approval boundaries.
creativity_rationale: Treating redaction as an agent security boundary, with non-reveal verification and consumable grants, is a fresh and ambitious interaction model.
creativity_evidence: verify_without_reveal avoids turning the agent into a raw-value reader.

usability_note: The safety contract is clear conceptually, but no product flow is visually evidenced.
red_flags: No visual or video evidence of the viewer, approval flow, or leakage protections.
standouts: Strong security-oriented WebMCP design with precise failure semantics.
advance_reason: Exceptional WebMCP/security concept and credible stated design, despite limited execution evidence.

one_line: Shared globe that visualizes aggregated AI-chat energy without storing conversation text.

leverage_rationale: WebMCP provides a privacy-preserving channel for an agent to report derived state from a conversation the page cannot and should not read; ordinary UI automation cannot cleanly provide that signal without transcript leakage.
leverage_evidence: Two tools accept energy totals while rejecting text/transcript/conversation/message/prompt/chat keys.

impact_evidence: Shared globe maps joy, work, strain, and other chat energy into persistent collective terrain.
